title: Best Conversion Rate Optimization Experts (2026): How to Hire
description: How to hire a CRO expert to turn more visitors into customers: what the work should include, what to prepare, price factors and red flags.
intro: Conversion rate optimization (CRO) is about getting more of your existing visitors to buy, book or sign up, instead of paying for more traffic. A CRO expert studies how people use your site, finds where they drop off, and tests changes. It goes wrong when changes are made on opinion alone, tests are stopped too early, or tracking is broken so nobody can tell what worked. This guide helps you hire for real, measurable improvements.

faq.q: What does a CRO expert actually do?
faq.a: They review your analytics, watch how users behave, find friction in key pages such as product, cart or sign-up, suggest changes and, where traffic allows, test them against the current version.

faq.q: Do I need a lot of traffic for A/B testing?
faq.a: Proper A/B tests need enough visitors and conversions to give reliable results. With low traffic, an expert can still audit your pages and fix clear problems, but formal tests may take too long.

faq.q: How long before I see results?
faq.a: Fixes to obvious problems can help quickly. Tests usually need to run for weeks to reach a reliable result. Beware of anyone who declares a winner after a day or two.

faq.q: What access will the expert need?
faq.a: Read access to analytics, and sometimes access to a testing tool or your site editor. Use separate user accounts, not your own login.

faq.q: Will they make the changes on my site?
faq.a: Some do; others give recommendations for your developer. Agree on this before starting.
